card.essence: A profound remedy for progressive paralytic states, contractures, and chronic rheumatic deformities in dark-haired, rigid-fibered persons with sallow complexions. Characterised by gradual loss of muscular power affecting single parts (vocal cords, eyelids, bladder, limbs), rawness and soreness of mucous membranes, and profound weakness progressing to paralysis. The mental state features intense sympathy for others' suffering, hopelessness from long-lasting grief, and anxious forebodings at twilight.
card.family: Hahnemann preparation · Tinctura acris sine Kali (exact composition unknown)
card.sides: Right-sided paralysis and facial paralysis; left-sided sciatica
card.thermal: Ambithermal — sensitive to both heat and cold; pains better warmth, but patient aggravated by extremes

keynotes.text: Progressive paralysis of single parts: vocal cords, eyelids, tongue, bladder, face, extremities
Rawness and soreness: scalp, throat, larynx, rectum, anus, urethra — as if bruised
Contractures of flexor tendons and muscles; joints become ankylosed
Urine involuntary when coughing, sneezing, blowing nose
Cough with inability to expectorate, sputa must be swallowed; relieved by cold water
Warts large, jagged, bleeding easily, pedunculated; on fingertips, nose, face
Menses cease at night, flow only during day
Never well since a burn; old burns re-open and become sore again
Children slow to learn to walk; unsteady walking and easy falling
Hoarseness with rawness and aphonia worse in morning

modalities_worse.text: Dry, cold, clear weather; cold dry winds and drafts
Coming from air into warm room
Thinking of complaints aggravates, especially haemorrhoids

modalities_better.text: Warmth of bed; warmth generally (for pains)
Cold drink, even during chills; swallowing cold water relieves cough

mentals: Child does not want to go to bed alone; afraid of the dark
Least thing makes child cry; intensely sympathetic to others' suffering
Sad, hopeless, melancholy — from long-lasting grief, care, or sorrow
Anxious forebodings, especially at twilight when shadows lengthen
Mental fatigue; reticent; conscience-stricken as if committed a crime
Ailments from sudden emotions: fear, fright, joy, anger, or suppressed eruptions
physicals: Gradual decrease of muscular power ending in paralysis; faint-like sinking of strength
Paralysis after exposure to cold wind, diphtheria, or typhoid; ptosis of upper eyelids
Contractures: tendons shorten (flexors, palms, hamstrings); muscles harden into ridges
Rheumatic deformities of joints with stiffness, ankylosis; worse dry weather
Tearing, drawing pains in muscles and fibrous tissues; burning in joints
Stool small, tough, covered with mucus, shines like grease; passes better standing
Cough dry, with rawness in chest; expectoration scanty, must be swallowed
Voice re-echoes in ears; hoarseness of singers and public speakers
Retention of urine after surgical operations; loss of sensation passing urine
Old burns freshen up, become sore again; patients never well since that burn
Left-sided sciatica with numbness; restless legs at night
Cracking and tension in knees; weak ankles, cannot walk without suffering
clinical: Chronic progressive paralysis: vocal cords (aphonia), bladder, facial, eyelids (ptosis)
Rheumatic affections with contractures and arthritic deformities
Stress incontinence: urine spurts on coughing, sneezing, laughing
Chronic laryngitis and hoarseness in professional voice users
Facial paralysis after exposure to cold wind (Bell's palsy)
Haemorrhoids sore and raw, worse walking, with constipation
Warts: large, jagged, pedunculated, bleeding; on face, fingers, nose
Never well since burns or scalds; keloid scars, old injuries re-open
Chorea at puberty; epilepsy; locomotor ataxia
Nocturnal enuresis in children with dark hair and rigid fibre

differentials.note: Incompatible — must not use before/after. Phos has haemorrhagic tendency, burning pains, right lung affinity; Caust more paralytic, contractures, bladder weakness.
Both have ptosis and progressive muscular weakness. Gels acute, from heat/sun, drowsy, trembling; Caust chronic, from cold wind, hopeless, contractures.
Both have ptosis. Sep has bearing-down uterine pains, aversion to family, yellow saddle on nose; Caust more paralytic with rawness and sympathetic nature.
Both have tearing pains, restlessness, better warmth. Rhus > continued motion, worse initial motion; Caust has contractures, paralysis, not > motion.
Complementary remedy. Carbo has flatulent dyspepsia, wants to be fanned, coldness; both have hoarseness worse evening (Caust worse morning).

cautions: Incompatible with Phosphorus — must not be used before or after; always disagrees
Patient may improve for a time then come to a 'standstill' — consider Psorinum or Sulphur
